name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Dialog: centred 3px panel with a screentone shadow that pops in over three steps; the overlay is a light screentone fixed to the screen (no blur, no moiré when zooming). Sizes sm, default, lg, full. DialogBody adds a scrolling region that keeps the shadow outside. flash adds a halo of concentration lines around the window as it opens (off by default).
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/dialog". It wraps your own components/ui/dialog, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A centred panel over a light screentone veil.
meta.usage:
import { Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/manga/dialog"

<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger>Open</DialogTrigger>
  <DialogContent size="sm"><DialogTitle>Leave the chapter?</DialogTitle></DialogContent>
</Dialog>

props.name: flash
props.description: On DialogContent: a halo of concentration lines around the window as it opens.
